description.value: Subway Torquay Village is a franchise location of the global Subway sandwich chain in the Torquay Village neighbourhood of Victoria. Cyclists can order customizable Footlongs, 6" sandwiches, wraps, and salads with fresh-cut vegetables and a choice of proteins and breads. The restaurant supports dine-in, takeout, and delivery, offering a convenient and quick refuelling stop on the Shelbourne corridor.

bike_parking_detail: 2 racks within 100m: rack at 83m; bollard (2 spaces) at 84m. Total: 2 spaces.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The Subway website loaded successfully and confirms an active franchise at 4091 Shelbourne Street, Victoria, BC V8N 5Y1, branded locally as 'Subway Torquay Village.' Phone (250) 590-2253 matches the OSM tag exactly, and the OSM takeaway=yes tag is corroborated by the website listing 'Order Pick Up,' 'Order Delivery,' and curbside pickup as service options. No mention of bike parking, washrooms, water refill, Wi-Fi, or any other cyclist-specific amenities appears in either the website content or OSM tags.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, active, publicly accessible fast-food restaurant confirmed by both OSM and its own website. A practical meal and takeout stop for touring cyclists on the Shelbourne corridor.
